name: How long does it take to complete a home renovation project with a general contractor?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete a home renovation project with a general contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a home renovation project varies greatly depending on its scope and complexity. A small bathroom remodel might take a few weeks, while a major home addition or whole-house renovation could take several months. A general contractor will provide a detailed project timeline, including milestones and an estimated completion date, after assessing the project requirements. Unforeseen issues can sometimes extend these timelines.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies by scope; a general contractor will provide a detailed timeline.
